audience.programmeDescription: Leiden University College The Hague studies global challenges such as sustainability, prosperity, diversity, peace and justice. In Culture, History and Society, students use the humanities and social sciences to examine how cultures, histories and social differences shape collective life.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The displayed 95 EC comprises the 45 EC first-year core, 10 EC of electives, 30 EC for a minor, further electives or study abroad, and 10 EC of Global Citizenship. The detailed 85 EC major requirements for students entering in September 2026, including the capstone and progression rules, still need confirmation. A complete comparison with UCR remains unfinished.

curriculum.limitation: Verified subset: 95 of 180 EC. The remaining 85 EC is the Culture, History and Society major. Its academic scope is known, but the catalogue gives different capstone and major-course credits for earlier graduating classes. The first-year choices count within the degree requirements and are not added again.

componentNotes.lagc06: One of the first-year mathematics choices.
componentNotes.elective-space-10: 10 EC of elective study within the degree framework. The first year also contains choices; these must be counted within the degree rather than added a second time.
componentNotes.flexible-space-30: 30 EC for a minor, additional electives or an approved semester abroad. The published programme places study abroad in the first semester of year three. An internship can contribute at most 5 EC under the published programme guidance.
componentNotes.global-citizenship-10: A 10 EC programme requirement developing cross-cultural communication and reflection. A specific language or Global Citizenship course is not selected in this partial inventory.
